stories.headline: Severe heatwave grips South and Southeast Asia, setting power-demand records

key_facts.fact: Northern Vietnam's peak power demand hit a record 24,722 MW on the afternoon of May 24, up 16% from the previous Sunday, forcing grid operator NSMO to start up expensive oil-fired plants (O Mon I units S1 and S2) to meet peak demand for May 25.
key_facts.excerpt: the peak afternoon consumption in the North reached 24,722 MW. Due to the scorching heat, the National Power Grid Corporation (NSMO) ordered the start-up of expensive oil-fired thermal power plants... NSMO has ordered the start-up of expensive oil-fired power plants S1 and S2 at O Mon I.

key_facts.fact: National Vietnamese electricity consumption on May 23 reached 1.116 billion kWh - the highest ever recorded on a Sunday, 12.8% above the prior Sunday - with the system peaking at 53,512 MW.
key_facts.excerpt: on May 23rd, the peak power of the national electricity system reached 53,512 MW at 1:45 PM... national electricity consumption reached the equivalent of 90% of a normal workday's consumption and was the highest level ever recorded on a Sunday (12.8% higher than the previous Sunday).

key_facts.fact: In India's Odisha state, peak power demand surged to a record 6,739 MW amid temperatures near 45C, almost 300 MW above last year's maximum, with Tata Power-led distribution companies on full emergency footing.
key_facts.excerpt: an intense heat wave pushing temperatures to 45 C and driving electricity consumption to new highs... The discoms are currently handling a peak demand of 6,739 MW, nearly 300 MW higher than last year's maximum of 6,447 MW.

key_facts.fact: In Telangana, at least 16 people died of heatstroke across seven districts over the weekend, prompting the state to announce 4 lakh rupees ex-gratia for each victim's family; Khammam recorded 45.4C on May 23.
key_facts.excerpt: At least 16 deaths have been recorded across seven districts in Telangana due to intense heat conditions... a maximum temperature of 45.4 degrees Celsius was recorded in Khammam on May 23.

key_facts.fact: The India Meteorological Department issued a fresh heatwave warning for nine Telangana districts for May 25 and warned that severe-heatwave conditions would continue through May 26.
key_facts.excerpt: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a heatwave warning in nine Telangana districts for Monday.

stories.headline: Crypto analytics firm Elliptic raises $120M Series D at $670M valuation

key_facts.fact: Elliptic, a digital-asset analytics company, closed a $120 million Series D led by One Peak, with participation from Nasdaq Ventures, Deutsche Bank and the British Business Bank; the round values Elliptic at $670 million.
key_facts.excerpt: Elliptic, the global leader in digital asset decisioning, today announced the closing of a $120 million Series D fundraise led by One Peak, with participation from Nasdaq Ventures, Deutsche Bank and the British Business Bank. The round values Elliptic at $670 million.

key_facts.fact: Existing backers AlbionVC, Evolution Equity Partners and J.P. Morgan also support the company; CEO Simone Maini said 'financial systems are being rebuilt on-chain.'
key_facts.excerpt: 'Financial systems are being rebuilt on-chain,' said Simone Maini, CEO of Elliptic... and the continued confidence of AlbionVC, Evolution Equity Partners and J.P. Morgan is a clear signal of their belief in us as market leaders.

stories.headline: HSBC lifts 2026 oil forecast to $95, warns energy shock is forcing rate hikes

key_facts.fact: HSBC raised its 2026 Brent crude average forecast by $15 to $95 a barrel, warning the supply shock's impact on global inflation is now hard to reverse even if a US-Iran deal reopens the Strait of Hormuz.
key_facts.excerpt: HSBC's global economics team released a new report significantly raising its 2026 Brent crude average price forecast by $15 to $95 per barrel, warning that even if a US-Iran deal is reached and the Strait of Hormuz reopens, the supply shock's impact on global inflation is now difficult to reverse.

key_facts.fact: HSBC expects the European Central Bank to hike rates 25 basis points each in June, July and September, with the Bank of England and Bank of Japan likely to hike between June and July.
key_facts.excerpt: HSBC expects the European Central Bank to raise rates by 25 basis points each in June, July, and September... The Bank of England and Bank of Japan may hike rates between June and July.

key_facts.fact: From February to April, energy contributed more than one percentage point to CPI in major US and eurozone economies, and as much as 3.9 points in Thailand and 2.8 points in the Philippines.
key_facts.excerpt: from February to April alone, energy contributed more than one percentage point to CPI increases in major US and eurozone economies; the impact was even more severe in Southeast Asia, reaching 3.9 percentage points in Thailand and 2.8 percentage points in the Philippines.

key_facts.fact: US trailing inflation has hit roughly a three-year high near 3.8%, with the Cleveland Fed nowcast pointing to about 4.18% for May, after Iran's late-February closure of the Strait of Hormuz halted some 20 million barrels a day of petroleum (about 20% of global demand).
key_facts.excerpt: Iran announced the closure of the Strait of Hormuz to virtually all commercial vessels. This halted the daily movement of approximately 20 million barrels of petroleum liquids (about 20% of global demand)... The Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland's Inflation Nowcasting tool... is calling for TTM inflation to rise another 38 basis points to 4.18% in May.

key_facts.fact: US April CPI rose to 3.8% year-on-year and PPI jumped to 6%, while the 30-year Treasury yield broke above 5% for the first time since 2007; markets see the Fed possibly dropping its easing bias at its June meeting under new Chair Kevin Warsh.
key_facts.excerpt: In April, the CPI surged to 3.8% year-on-year... and PPI jumped to 6% year-on-year... The 30-year Treasury yield broke through 5%, reaching its highest level since 2007... The June meeting is anticipated to remove the easing bias, signaling a hawkish stance.

stories.headline: Huawei unveils 'Tau Scaling Law' to chase 1.4nm-equivalent chips by 2031 without EUV

key_facts.fact: He Tingbo, president of Huawei's semiconductor business and director of its Scientist Committee, presented the Tau (τ) Scaling Law in a keynote titled 'New Semiconductor Path in Practice' at the 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Circuits and Systems (ISCAS) in Shanghai.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, at the 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Circuits and Systems (ISCAS), He Tingbo from HUAWEI delivered a keynote speech titled "New Semiconductor Path in Practice". In her speech, she presented the Tau (τ) Scaling Law, a new principle for guiding the future development of the semiconductor industry.

key_facts.fact: The Tau Scaling Law proposes replacing geometric scaling (shrinking transistors) with 'time scaling' — using τ to denote signal propagation delay — claiming chips that run faster and more efficiently even without the world's most advanced fabrication equipment restricted by US sanctions.
key_facts.excerpt: The Tau Scaling Law proposes replacing geometric scaling with time scaling — using the Greek letter τ (tau) to denote signal propagation delay — as the new guiding principle... instead of building narrower roads, Huawei is shortening the distances signals need to travel.

key_facts.fact: By 2031, Huawei expects the high-end chips it designs using the τ Scaling Law to feature transistor density equivalent to 14 Å (1.4nm) processes — near the projected global frontier that TSMC and Samsung are expected to reach via conventional lithography.
key_facts.excerpt: By 2031, the high-end chips HUAWEI designs based on the τ Scaling Law are expected to feature a transistor density that is equivalent to 14 Å (1.4 nm) processes.

key_facts.fact: Kirin chips scheduled to launch in Fall 2026 will be the first to adopt Huawei's LogicFolding architecture, which shortens critical-path wiring to reduce signal delay; Huawei says it has designed and mass-produced 381 chips based on the τ Scaling Law over the past six years.
key_facts.excerpt: Over the past six years, HUAWEI has designed and mass-produced 381 chips based on the τ Scaling Law... The Kirin chips scheduled to launch in Fall 2026 will be the first ever to adopt the LogicFolding architecture.

key_facts.fact: Chinese semiconductor stocks rallied on the announcement: SMIC jumped more than 17% in Shanghai trading, Cambricon climbed nearly 10%, and Piotech gained over 18%.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corp. (SMIC) jumped more than 17% in Shanghai trading. Cambricon Technologies climbed nearly 10%, while Piotech Inc gained over 18%.

key_facts.fact: Huawei released no independent benchmark or manufacturing data; analysts caution that an 'equivalent' 1.4nm density does not match a true 1.4nm-class process from a leading foundry, and Huawei's current Kirin chips are made by SMIC at processes estimated at roughly 7nm.
key_facts.excerpt: The company did not release independent benchmark data or manufacturing metrics confirming the claimed performance levels... manufactured by SMIC using production technologies analysts estimate to be between 7 nm and 5 nm.

stories.headline: Pope Leo XIV's first encyclical 'Magnifica humanitas' urges a slower pace on AI

key_facts.fact: Pope Leo XIV released his first encyclical, 'Magnifica humanitas: On Safeguarding the Human Person in the Time of Artificial Intelligence,' on Monday, May 25, 2026; the text was signed May 15, the 135th anniversary of Leo XIII's labor encyclical Rerum novarum.
key_facts.excerpt: Marking the 135th anniversary of Rerum novarum, Pope Leo XIV releases his first encyclical, entitled 'Magnifica humanitas: On Safeguarding the Human Person in the Time of Artificial Intelligence.' ... Published on Monday, May 25, the Pope signed the encyclical on May 15.

key_facts.fact: The encyclical calls for 'prudence, rigorous evaluation and even, at times, a slower pace in adopting AI,' and for 'more active political involvement that is capable of slowing things down when everything is accelerating.'
key_facts.excerpt: 'Calling for prudence, rigorous evaluation and even, at times, a slower pace in adopting AI does not mean opposing progress; instead, it is an exercise of responsible care for the human family,' Pope Leo wrote. ... 'What is needed is a more active political involvement that is capable of slowing things down when everything is accelerating.'

key_facts.fact: In the ~43,000-word document, Pope Leo urged governments to slow the development of AI systems and decried 'new forms of slavery' in AI and tech supply chains.
key_facts.excerpt: In his ~43,000-word encyclical, the Pope urged governments to slow down AI development and decried 'new forms of slavery' in AI and tech supply chains.

key_facts.fact: The encyclical argues AI cannot be considered morally neutral, calls for adequate AI policies, legal frameworks, independent oversight and user education, and says data 'should not be treated as something to be sold off or entrusted to a select few' but managed as a 'common or shared good.'
key_facts.excerpt: The pope argues that 'we cannot consider AI to be morally neutral' ... data cannot be left solely in private hands and 'should not be treated as something to be sold off or entrusted to a select few,' calling for appropriate regulation and creative thinking to 'manage data as a common or shared good.'

key_facts.fact: The encyclical warns AI 'can imitate and simulate the person, but it does not possess a moral conscience, empathy, or affective, relational or spiritual capabilities,' and cautions against the 'technocratic paradigm' where choices are dictated by efficiency and profit.
key_facts.excerpt: Pope Leo warns about the 'technocratic paradigm' ... AI can imitate and simulate the person, but it does not possess a moral conscience, empathy, or affective, relational or spiritual capabilities.

key_facts.fact: Christopher Olah, co-founder of Anthropic and head of its AI interpretability research, was among the official speakers who presented the encyclical with the Pope at the Vatican's Synod Hall on May 25.
key_facts.excerpt: The Document will be presented on 25 May 2026 at 11.30, in the Synod Hall, in the presence of the Holy Father. ... Christopher Olah, co-founder of Anthropic, United States of America, and head of research on the interpretability of artificial intelligence.

key_facts.fact: A section of the encyclical describing AI's unpredictability suggests influence from Anthropic, whose co-founder attended the unveiling.
key_facts.excerpt: A section of the Pope's encyclical describing AI's unpredictability suggests influence from Anthropic, whose co-founder Christopher Olah attended the unveiling.

key_facts.fact: The encyclical also calls for AI regulation and for protection of children against hypersexualized AI-generated images.
key_facts.excerpt: Pope Leo XIV presents Magnifica humanitas, his encyclical on AI, calling for AI regulation, protection for children against hypersexualized AI images, and more.

stories.headline: Russia hits Kyiv region with Oreshnik missile in massive attack; EU vows more pressure

key_facts.fact: Russia launched a massive combined missile-and-drone attack on Ukraine overnight into May 24, firing 90 missiles and 600 drones; Ukraine's Air Force said it shot down or suppressed 604 targets (55 missiles and 549 drones), with Kyiv the main target.
key_facts.excerpt: Russia launched a massive combined attack on Ukraine overnight on May 24... firing 90 missiles and 600 drones... Ukrainian air defenses shot down or suppressed 604 targets - 55 missiles and 549 drones... Kyiv was the main target.

key_facts.fact: President Zelensky said Russia used its nuclear-capable Oreshnik intermediate-range ballistic missile for the third time in the war, striking Bila Tserkva in Kyiv Oblast - the first time the weapon has been directed at the Kyiv region.
key_facts.excerpt: Russia launched its sophisticated medium-range Oreshnik ballistic missile at Ukraine's Kyiv Oblast during a massive combined missile and drone attack overnight on May 24... The targeting of Bila Tserkva marks the third known use of the Oreshnik missile against Ukraine, and the first time the weapon has been directed at Kyiv Oblast.

key_facts.fact: At least two people were killed and 83 wounded in the bombardment, one of the heaviest on Kyiv since the war began.
key_facts.excerpt: At least 2 dead, 83 wounded after Russia uses nuclear-capable missile in massive attack on Ukraine... Russia used a powerful hypersonic missile to carry out a massive attack Sunday in Kyiv, which killed at least two people.

key_facts.fact: Russia's Defense Ministry confirmed using the Oreshnik and other missile types to strike Ukrainian military command-and-control facilities, air bases and military-industrial sites, calling it retaliation for Ukrainian strikes on civilian facilities in Russia.
key_facts.excerpt: Russia's Defense Ministry on Sunday confirmed the weapon's use, as well as other missile types, to strike Ukrainian 'military command and control facilities,' air bases and military industrial enterprises. The ministry added the attack was retaliation for Ukrainian attacks on 'civilian facilities on Russian territory.'

key_facts.fact: At a UN Security Council emergency meeting requested by Russia, Ukraine's ambassador Andrii Melnyk dismissed Russia's war-crimes accusations as a 'pure propaganda show.'
key_facts.excerpt: At a U.N. Security Council emergency meeting on the strike, held at the request of Russia, Ukrainian Ambassador Andrii Melnyk denied his Russian counterpart's accusations of war crimes, calling them a 'pure propaganda show.'

key_facts.fact: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas called the Oreshnik use 'reckless nuclear brinkmanship' and said EU foreign ministers will meet next week to dial up pressure on Russia, while Macron, Merz and von der Leyen condemned the strikes.
key_facts.excerpt: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz condemned the attack as a 'reckless escalation'... French President Emmanuel Macron also condemned the latest Russian strikes... Kallas called the reported use of the 'Oreshnik' missile particularly alarming, describing it as 'reckless nuclear brinkmanship.' EU foreign ministers are expected to discuss further pressure on Russia next week.

stories.headline: US and Iran near deal to end war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz

key_facts.fact: Regional officials said the US is close to a deal with Iran that would end the war, reopen the Strait of Hormuz and see Iran give up its stockpile of highly enriched uranium.
key_facts.excerpt: The United States is close to reaching a deal with Iran that would end the war, reopen the Strait of Hormuz and see Iran give up its stockpile of highly enriched uranium, regional officials told The Associated Press on Sunday.

key_facts.fact: Trump said the agreement, a 'Memorandum of Understanding pertaining to PEACE,' had been 'largely negotiated' after calls with Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Pakistan, Turkey, Egypt, Jordan, Bahrain and, separately, Israel.
key_facts.excerpt: President Donald Trump said Saturday that a deal with Iran on the war, including opening the Strait of Hormuz, has been 'largely negotiated'... He described it as a 'Memorandum of Understanding pertaining to PEACE.'

key_facts.fact: A senior US official said Sunday the deal is expected to be signed 'in the coming days,' with wording still being finalized, after the broad framework was approved by Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei.
key_facts.excerpt: The United States is expected to sign an agreement to end the war with Iran 'in the coming days,' a senior US official reportedly told reporters on Sunday, after the broad framework of the deal was approved by Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei.

key_facts.fact: Under the emerging agreement the Strait of Hormuz would gradually reopen in parallel with the US ending its blockade, the US would allow Iran to sell oil through sanctions waivers, and a 60-day period would cover negotiations on Iran's nuclear program; the draft also includes ending the Israel-Hezbollah fighting in Lebanon.
key_facts.excerpt: Under the emerging agreement, the Strait of Hormuz would gradually reopen in parallel with the U.S. ending its blockade... The U.S. would allow Iran to sell its oil through sanctions waivers... Both officials said the draft deal includes an end to the war between Israel and the Iran-backed Hezbollah militant group in Lebanon.

key_facts.fact: Netanyahu said he and Trump agreed any final agreement 'must eliminate the nuclear danger' - meaning dismantling Iran's enrichment sites and removing enriched material - while the NYT reported the US has largely excluded Israel from the talks.
key_facts.excerpt: Netanyahu... said he had spoken to Trump... 'agreed that any final agreement with Iran must eliminate the nuclear danger.' 'That means dismantling Iran's nuclear enrichment sites and removing its enriched nuclear material from its territory'... The New York Times reported that the US has almost completely excluded Israel from the negotiations.

stories.headline: Peking University spinout Vifan raises hundreds of millions of yuan for a domestic robot 'brain' chip

key_facts.fact: Beijing Vifan Intelligence Technology, incubated from Peking University's brain-inspired chip lab (PAICORE Lab) and founded in May 2025, has completed a seed round of several hundred million yuan to build a fully domestic 'brain' computing chip for embodied-AI robots.
key_facts.excerpt: 北京维泛智能科技有限公司（以下简称"维泛智能"）近日完成数亿元种子轮融资... 维泛智能成立于2025年5月，孵化自北京大学类脑芯片实验室（PAICORE Lab），专注于具身智能"大小脑"融合芯片研发，致力于打造全国产化机器人核心计算方案。

key_facts.fact: The round was co-led by Zhongguancun Capital and its Qihang Investment arm, with participation from the Shanghai Future Industry Fund, Shixi Capital, Biwin Storage, Yanchuang Group, Haiyi Investment, and Tanyuan Venture.
key_facts.excerpt: 由中关村资本及旗下启航投资联合领投，上海未来产业基金、石溪资本、佰维存储、燕创集团、海益投资、探元创投共同投资。

key_facts.fact: Vifan has developed a Brain-Inspired GPU (BiGPU) architecture that fuses neuromorphic spiking-neural-network computing with general-purpose GPU compute, aiming to cut power use while keeping broad algorithm compatibility for robot perception, AI inference, and motion control.
key_facts.excerpt: 自主研发了类脑启发式GPU架构（Brain-Inpsired GPU，BiGPU)，融合类脑计算与通用GPU计算能力，为具身智能SOTA大模型原生设计。通过引入类脑计算机制降低功耗，同时保留GPU对多种算法框架的通用适配能力。

key_facts.fact: The company is positioning itself as a domestic alternative to Nvidia's Jetson series, which dominates the robot-brain chip market but is described as costly with limited local support; Vifan targets chip production in the second quarter of 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: 目前，具身智能"大脑"芯片市场高度依赖英伟达Jetson系列，但存在着价格高昂、本地化支持有限，商业化部署门槛较高问题... 预计于2027年第二季度实现芯片投产。

key_facts.fact: Co-founder Yin Jilei is a Peking University graduate with more than 20 years in semiconductors, previously COO and VP of R&D at Witmem Technology and a chip R&D director at IBM and GlobalFoundries; core team members come from IBM, Huawei, and Tencent.
key_facts.excerpt: 联合创始人殷积磊毕业于北京大学，拥有超过20年半导体行业经验，曾任知存科技COO兼研发副总裁，以及IBM、GlobalFoundries芯片研发总监... 团队核心成员均来自IBM、华为、腾讯等行业头部企业。
